sagabbha: sagabbha (adj.) [sa3+gabbha] with a fœtus, pregnant Mhvs 33, 46.
sagaha: sagaha (adj.) [sa3+gaha2] full of crocodiles It 57, 114. As sagāha at S IV.157.
sagāmeyya: sagāmeyya (adj.) [grd. formation fr. gāma,+sa2=saṃ°) hailing from the same village S I.36, 60.
sagārava: sagārava (adj.) [sa3+gārava] respectful, usually combd with sappatissa & other syn., e. g. Vin I.45; It 10; Vism 19, 221.
saguṇa: saguṇa (adj.) [either sa3+guṇa  1, as given under guṇa ; or sa°=saṃ° once, as in sakṛt,+guṇa  2] either "with the string," or "in one"; Vin I.46 (saguṇaṃ karoti to put together, to fold up; C ekato katvā). This interpretation (as "put together") is much to be preferred to the one given under guṇa  1; saguṇaṃ katvā belongs to sanghāṭiyo, and not to kāyabandhanaṃ, thus: "the upper robes are to be given, putting them into one (bundle)."
saguḷa: saguḷa [sa3+guḷa2] a cake with sugar J VI.524. Cp. sanguḷikā.
sagocara: sagocara [sa2=saṃ, +gocara] companion, mate (lit. having the same activity) J II.31.
sagotta: sagotta [sa2=saṃ,+gotta] a kinsman J V.411; cp. VI.500.
sagga: sagga [Vedic svarga, svar+ga] 1. heaven, the next world, popularly conceived as a place of happiness and long life (cp. the pop. etym. of "suṭṭhu--aggattā sagga" PvA 9; "rūpādīhi visayehi suṭṭhu aggo ti saggo" Vism 427); usually the kām"âvacara--devaloka, sometimes also the 26 heavens (ThA 74). Sometimes as sagga ṭhāna (cp. °loka), e. g. J VI.210. -- Vin I.223; D II.86; III.52, 146 sq.; M I.22, 483; S I.12; A I.55 sq., 292 sq.; II.83 sq.; III.244, 253 sq.; IV.81; V.135 sq.; Sn 224 (loc. pl. saggesu); It 14; Pv I.13; Vism 103, 199.  --âpāya heaven and hell Th 2, 63; Sn 647. --ārohaṇa (--sopāna) (the stairs) leading to heaven (something like Jacob"s ladder) Vism 10. --kathā discourse or talk about heaven Vin I.15 (cp. anupubbikathā) --kāya the heavenly assembly (of the gods) J VI.573. --dvāra heaven"s gate Vism 57. --patha=sagga J I.256. --pada heavenly region, heaven J II.5; IV.272 (=saggaloka). --magga the way to heaven J VI.287; DhA I.4. --loka the heavenworld M I.73; J IV.272. --saṃvattanika leading to heaven D III.66.
saghaccā: saghaccā (f.) [sat+ghaccā] just or true killing J I.177.
